summary.name: Pixwit
summary.one_liner: Pixwit is an AI creative studio for generating video, images and music from text or reference images, with multiple models in one browser workspace.
use_cases: animate a still image into video
direct camera movement in generated video
summary.what_it_does: Pixwit lets users write a scene description or upload frames and reference images as a starting point. Users then pick a model, output format, duration and camera direction. After generating, they can preview the result, adjust settings, and download or edit it. The page describes the product as covering video, images and music, with multiple AI models, reference-based workflows and browser editing tools. The visible page text focuses on a Marketing Studio for product stills into ads and UGC clips, and does not list specific models.
notable: Describe a scene or upload reference frames, then direct model, format, duration and camera movement
